It has been brought to my attention that despite the completion and delivery of graphic design work as per Agreement No. GFX-2025-001, signed on 10th January 2025, my client has not received the agreed payment of ₹75,000. The work was delivered on 15th February 2025, and despite repeated reminders sent on 20th February 2025 and 5th March 2025, the payment remains outstanding.

This non-payment constitutes a breach of contract under the Indian Contract Act, 1872. Furthermore, the delay in payment and lack of response to the reminders has caused my client financial distress and mental agony.

In light of the above, my client demands the immediate payment of the outstanding amount of ₹75,000 along with a compensation of ₹25,000 for the delay and distress caused. The total amount due is ₹1,00,000.

Please treat this as a final reminder and make the necessary payment within 15 days from the receipt of this notice. Failure to comply will compel my client to initiate appropriate legal proceedings against your company, and all the costs of such proceedings shall be borne by you.
